column4: Pixel-art mouse cursor icon from a 1990s Build-engine game's interface (Duke Nukem 3D, Redneck Rampage), matching the reference image's pixel size, dark outline, palette and shading: a single wide-open human eye seen straight from the front, almond-shaped, its white slightly yellowed, a brown iris and a black pupil with one small white highlight, a heavy upper lid with a few short dark lashes, drawn as a chunky simple icon that reads at 24 pixels. One eye only, centred, nothing else. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, no shadow, no text, no border, no watermark.

Pixel-art texture in the style of 1990s Build-engine games (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Redneck Rampage): a digitized photograph crudely retouched by hand by a 1996 game artist, flat even lighting, no glow, no bloom, no steam, no smoke, no depth of field, no soft shadows, chunky pixels, a limited muddy palette, low saturation, slightly grimy and imperfect, hard edges, no readable text, no logos, no border, no watermark, no people, no hands. A flat orthographic view straight down from above, no perspective, filling the whole 16:9 canvas edge to edge: The worn plank top of a small wooden table at the end of a roadside sweetcorn stand. At the far left a stack of white plastic cups upside down. Left of the middle a round grey metal drip grate set into the planks, wet. Right of the middle a bare stretch of planks, empty. At the right a flat cardboard tray with a pile of empty clear plastic bags and a bundle of bendy striped drinking straws.

Pixel-art first-person POV sprite exactly like the hand and weapon sprites of a 1990s Build-engine game (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Redneck Rampage). The player's hand wears EXACTLY the worn tan leather work glove of the reference image, with the same rolled-up grey work-shirt sleeve, same pixel size, palette and shading. TRUE FIRST-PERSON VIEW: the camera is the player's own eyes, standing behind a counter and looking forward and down at the work on it; we see only what the player sees of their own RIGHT hand and forearm, coming up from the bottom RIGHT edge of the picture and reaching forward, with correct perspective and foreshortening. The gloved hand is open and empty, reaching forward and down towards the counter ahead to pick something up: the back of the glove towards us, the fingers slightly spread and curved, the fingertips furthest away. Only ONE gloved hand and ONE forearm in the whole picture, no second hand, no bare skin, nothing held that is not described. Chunky pixels, strong simple shading, low saturation, the forearm touches the bottom edge of the canvas. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around the arm, no shadow, no counter, no table, no text, no border, no watermark.
